segments.normalizedSource: Overview
segments.contextBefore: Test your app against the arm64e architecture to ensure that it works seamlessly with enhanced security features.
segments.contextAfter: The arm64e architecture introduces pointer authentication codes (PACs) to detect and guard against unexpected changes to pointers in memory.

segments.contextBefore: The arm64e architecture introduces pointer authentication codes (PACs) to detect and guard against unexpected changes to pointers in memory.
